offending_extra_words: if Licensor does not cure within thirty (30) days of notice
EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH IN THIS ARTICLE,
reasons: Both levels fail on the conformance standard: the inserted warranty says the Software/Documentation and services will conform 'in all material respects', whereas the playbook position requires conformance to documentation without a materiality qualifier.
The services limb measures conformance against 'the requirements of this Agreement' rather than the Documentation, so the 90-day services conformance element is not squarely met.

Remedy set is padded: 're-performance' is outside the repair/replace/refund set, and the refund is further conditioned on 'if Licensor does not cure within thirty (30) days of notice', narrowing the remedy we asked for.

Minimality fails: operation 1 rewrites the disclaimer opener (18 to 28 words) where a shorter carve-out would suffice, and the insertion adds unnecessary boilerplate ('consistent with industry standards').
Intent is impaired by introducing 'Specifications', which is not a resolved defined term in the agreement, creating a dangling reference in the conformance warranty.

Fix: delete 'in all material respects' (both limbs), point the services limb at the Documentation, drop 're-performance' and the 30-day cure condition on refund, and remove the undefined 'Specifications'.
